name: Nuevo Baztán (Spain)
description: Green field within a border of yellow chain, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nuevo Baztán (chequy of white and black above a tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Nuevo Baztán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Nuevo Baztán arms — chequy of white and black above a tree on white
